Scrawny Bugbear is sleeping in the Blighted Village during Act One.

Involvement

Act One

The bugbear is  Sleeping next to an unfinished meal of wine and  Rotten Chicken Eggs in the Blighted Village at X: 33 Y: 441.

If the Scrawny Bugbear is woken up (by doing damage or other hostile actions), he becomes permanently hostile to the party.
